findings.claim: R41's removal of paired own-account transfers rests on R8's pairing 'within the configured number of days'. The window is a module constant, PAIRING_DAYS = 3, and nothing reads it from firm.yaml, the thresholds file or the profile. A firm cannot set it, and the snapshot does not pin it.
findings.repro: grep -rn PAIRING_DAYS src: the only uses are the definition and the default argument of pair_own_accounts. overrides.case_figures (src/cma/overrides.py:396) passes no days. A main-to-savings move four days apart (PAIR_SAVINGS with S2 on 2026-01-10) stays unpaired and unexplained whatever the firm configures.

findings.claim: The performance claim (R52 on a 10,000-line two-account case: 1.2 s warm, 1.67 s summary, 2.79 s cold) comes from a scratchpad probe that the runner did not run. The existing R52 tests use one-account cases, so the claim is not proven for multi-account cases.
findings.repro: grep r52 in specified-3.log: only tests/test_workspace_overrides.py::test_r52_* ran, on one-account _big cases. No runner tier ran the claim's probe.py.
